abilities.name: Rite of Dispelling Winds
_curatorNotes: FrameMaps from gcsim gcsim PR #2639 (MERGED 2026-08-24; bugfixes #2740 re-verified 2026-09-15 against main ac2d76dde — E/Q slices unchanged, normals/charge/burst gained their real `anim` and the burst its application[] via the migration)); may shift before merge.

Normal hits: attack.go attackHitmarks = [10, 13, 42], attackFrames init. N1 = InitNormalCancelSlice(10, 27), ActionAttack=15, ActionCharge=18. N2 = InitNormalCancelSlice(13, 31), ActionAttack=20, ActionCharge=19. N3 = InitNormalCancelSlice(42, 90), ActionCharge=81 (ActionAttack not overridden, so N=animation=90). swap = hitmark per convention.
chargeFrames: charge.go chargeFrames init = InitAbilSlice(86), ActionAttack/Charge/Skill/Burst=64, ActionDash/Jump=45 (=chargeHitmark), ActionSwap=62. Catalyst charged shot (chargeHitmark=45).

plungeFrames: plunge.go lowPlungeFrames init = InitAbilSlice(71), ActionAttack/Charge/Burst=50, ActionSkill=38 (=lowPlungeHitmark), ActionDash=42 (61-19), ActionSwap=57. This ground low-plunge (Ifa is Anemo catalyst) is only reachable in-game after his Nightsoul state ends (plunge.go gates it on plungeAvailableKey); authored for completeness but not a standalone rotation staple.

IN-NIGHTSOUL NORMALS (Tonicshots / Supporting Fire) are NOT these frames: while in Nightsoul's Blessing, attack.go/charge.go reroute N to attackTapSkillState (Tap, hitmark 3, interval attackSkillInterval=54f) and attackHoldSkillState (Hold, hitmark 1, interval chargeSkillInterval=42f), tagged AttackTagNormal with skill_dmg scaling (Tonicshot DMG 240.0% at TL10). These Tonicshots carry the team heal (skill.healCB) and are what a real Ifa rotation fires; the planner represents them as normal-attack hits during the Nightsoul window and the skill's onHit(normal) heal fires on them. Base ground normals above (Rite of Dispelling Winds) are the out-of-Nightsoul combo.

abilities.name: Airborne Disease Prevention
abilities.caveat: The cooldown is shown starting when the hover ends, assuming the full ~10s Nightsoul state; ending it early (dashes or the Hold plunge) starts the cooldown sooner.
_curatorNotes: Skill frames from gcsim gcsim PR #2639 (MERGED 2026-08-24; bugfixes #2740 re-verified 2026-09-15 against main ac2d76dde — E/Q slices unchanged, normals/charge/burst gained their real `anim` and the burst its application[] via the migration). skill.go skillFrames = InitAbilSlice(31), ActionCharge=28, ActionSkill=17, ActionBurst=5, ActionDash=28, ActionSwap=589+42=631. The ActionSwap=631 is a gcsim modeling artifact ('wait for nightsoul to run out and fall onto the ground') — it encodes the swap-lock, not the entry animation. Since the Nightsoul window is modeled separately as duration:10, swap is authored as the InitAbilSlice entry-animation default (31) rather than 631, so the E cast bar is not painted ~10.5s long. CanQueueAfter in gcsim = ActionBurst = 5 (earliest cancel into Q).

behavior:stance + opensState:nightsoulBlessing + duration:10 + terminatesOnSwap:false. Duration derived from the deterministic drain: enterNightsoul grants 80 Nightsoul points (skill talent 'Nightsoul Point Limit' = 80) and nightsoulPointReduceFunc drains 0.8 per 6 frames = 8/sec, so pure hover = 80/8 = 10s (KQM quickguide: 'State lasts approximately 10 seconds'). Dashing (13.5/dash) or a Hold-E plunge ends it earlier; canonical hover window is 10s (matches iansan/kinich Nightsoul-stance treatment). terminatesOnSwap:false because gcsim ActionReady blocks swap while Nightsoul points > 0 — the stance keeps Ifa on-field until it drains.

Cooldown: the CD clock starts AT NIGHTSOUL EXIT, not on cast. ⚠️ Ifa is NOT in the gcsim checkout (as of d146b6d, 2026-07-26), so the original gcsim citation here was written by analogy to Xilonen and could not be checked; the mechanic is confirmed instead by the Fandom wiki's Airborne Disease Prevention Gameplay Notes, verbatim: 'The 7.5s cooldown starts once Ifa's Nightsoul's Blessing state ends and not upon the Elemental Skill cast.' Authored cooldown:7.5 (sidecar CD = 7.5s at all levels). Encoded 2026-07-20 as cooldownStartDelay:600 (Nate decision, A7 follow-up); replaced 2026-08-15 with cooldownStartsAtStanceEnd, which says the same thing without borrowing a field that means animation frames. Effective downtime ~17.5s, consistent with the 10s hover bar. Early exits (dashes 13.3 points each, Hold-E plunge landing) start the real CD sooner — surfaced in the caveat.

⚓ terminatesOnSwap: false is CORRECT for Ifa and must NOT be flipped to match Xilonen (verified in-game by Nate, 2026-08-15). The two look parallel and are not: Xilonen swaps out instantly and her Blade Roller dies with the swap, but Ifa is AIRBORNE — he has to be brought down first, by cancelling the flight or by the in-flight Hold-E plunge, and only THEN can you swap. His cooldown starts when he LANDS, which is not the swap and is not a fixed offset from the cast. Modelling him properly therefore needs stance-CANCEL mechanics (a token that terminates a stance rather than opening one), which the parser has no notion of — the same machinery Xilonen's E-re-press would need. Until that exists, the authored 10s hover is the natural point-drain landing and cooldownStartsAtStanceEnd reads it correctly; an early landing is the unmodelled case, surfaced in the caveat.

Tonicshot Healing On Hit: authored as onHit(normal) team heal gated on state:nightsoulBlessing so it fires on the in-Nightsoul Supporting Fire Tonicshots (attack.go/charge.go reroute N while HasBlessing) and never on the out-of-stance ground combo. gcsim skill.healCB: healAmt = skill_heal[TL]*EM + skill_heal_flat[TL], Player.Heal with Target:-1 (all party). TL10: skill_heal[9]=0.36288 -> 36.3% EM; skill_heal_flat[9]=105.93467 -> flat 105.9 (sidecar 'Tonicshot Healing On Hit' col 10 = '36.3% Elemental Mastery+105.9'). No proc ICD (KQM: heals on every hit; row labelled 'On Hit'). Both Tap and Hold Supporting Fire heal, so a single onHit(normal) heal covers both.

[A7] Caveat trimmed to the delayed-cooldown-start divergence. Dropped as already-modeled working behavior: the ~10s Nightsoul hover stance (behavior:stance + duration:10 + terminatesOnSwap:false), the onHit(normal) team heal fired by the in-Nightsoul Tonicshots (drawn on the hover window), and the on-field swap-lock. Effective downtime ~17.5s = ~10s hover + 7.5s CD, since the CD clock starts at stance exit, not at cast.
nonHitting (non-hitting casts round, 2026-09-16 (docs/nonhitting-casts-round.md §1)): gcsim ifa/skill.go:105-127 → enterNightsoul, no QueueAttack; damage from Tonicshots and the hold plunge.
abilities.description:
It's time for the real bash bros to step up! Ifa calls Cacucu in as backup.
After using this skill, Ifa gains 80 Nightsoul points and enters the **Nightsoul's Blessing** state. In the Nightsoul's Blessing state, Ifa will hover with Cacucu's help. When he uses Normal Attacks in this state, he will use different kinds of **Supporting Fire** depending on whether you Tap or Hold, firing Tonicshots that are capable of healing all party members.

Additionally, Holding the Elemental Skill Airborne Disease Prevention while Ifa is in Nightsoul's Blessing will cause him to use a Nightsoul-aligned Plunging Attack. Letting go of the skill button will interrupt this Plunging Attack to maintain his hover. If Ifa lands due to this Plunging Attack, his Nightsoul's Blessing state will end.

abilities.name: Compound Sedation Field
_curatorNotes: Burst frames from gcsim gcsim PR #2639 (MERGED 2026-08-24; bugfixes #2740 re-verified 2026-09-15 against main ac2d76dde — E/Q slices unchanged, normals/charge/burst gained their real `anim` and the burst its application[] via the migration). burst.go grounded cast set burstFramesGrounded = InitAbilSlice(95), ActionAttack/Charge/Skill/Jump=79, ActionDash=78, ActionSwap=76. Authored the grounded set (default standalone Q). A faster in-Nightsoul set exists (burstFramesNS = InitAbilSlice(79), ActionAttack=67, ActionCharge/Skill=68, ActionDash=64) used when cast while hovering — not modeled as a variant.
Cooldown: burst.go SetCD(ActionBurst, 15*60) = 15s (sidecar CD 15.0s). Energy cost 60 (sidecar; EnergyMax=60). No SetCDWithDelay -> no cooldownStartDelay. burstHitmark=41, sedationMarkHitmark=38.

tag 'grouping': the burst's Therapeutic Sedative explodes into a restraining wind current that pulls nearby objects/opponents in (KQM quickguide). Base wind-current duration NOT authored as a summon — gcsim burst.go models only the single burst hit + Sedation Mark callback, no ticking field, and the game gives no explicit base duration (C4 extends the current 'to 3s'); per 'never fake timing' the pull window is left unmodeled and surfaced only via the grouping tag.

Damage NOT authored (support; on-field, not decision-relevant for planner/Team-Builder capabilities): main hit burst_dmg TL10 = 915.3% ATK Anemo (sidecar 'Skill DMG' col 10 = 915.3%); Sedation Mark burst_mark TL10 = 196.1% ATK (sidecar 'Sedation Mark DMG' col 10) dealt in the ABSORBED aura element (Pyro>Hydro>Electro>Cryo priority, burst.go targetElement) when the sedative hits an enemy affected by Hydro/Pyro/Cryo/Electro, applying a Sedation Mark (max ~4). The variable-element reaction-enabling hit is not cleanly authorable (element depends on enemy aura).

↻ CAVEAT REMOVED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass, Nate-approved): no pixel — The blank under the Q. The burst is tagged `grouping` and authors no summon, so it draws one instant cast bar and nothing else — where every other grouping field a player has seen in this tool (Venti's Stormeye, Sucrose, Kazuha) gets a bar in the summon lane with a length they can plan around. ⚠️ THE WEAKEST KEEP IN THIS BATCH and the one genuine coin-flip: no drawn thing is wrong, the missing quantity is one the game itself never states, and a player therefore has no specific expectation to violate. Flagging rather than deciding — if Nate wants the column tighter, delete this one first. Category: expected-but-absent.
abilities.description:
Fires a Therapeutic Sedative at a (temporarily aggressive) opponent. The sedative will explode on impact, creating a restraining wind current that pulls nearby objects and opponents in while dealing Nightsoul-aligned AoE Anemo DMG.
When the Therapeutic Sedative hits an opponent affected by Hydro/Pyro/Cryo/Electro, it will apply a **Sedation Mark** to them.

passives.name: Field Medic's Vision
passives.caveat: Not modeled: the Swirl and Electro-Charged DMG share. The +12% Lunar-Charged buff shown assumes a fixed 60 Rescue Essentials points; in game the bonus scales with the party’s total Nightsoul, rising and falling in real time.
_curatorNotes: Field Medic's Vision = Ascension 1 (gcsim asc.go a1Init, Base.Ascension < 1 guard). No gcsim source for Ifa existed before PR #2639; A1 numbers from KQM quickguide + Fandom wiki + genshin-db talent text: each Rescue Essentials point grants +1.5% Swirl DMG, +1.5% Electro-Charged DMG, +0.2% Lunar-Charged DMG to nearby party members; Rescue Essentials cap 150 (C0), 200 (C2); points = total party Nightsoul while in Blessing, cleared when Blessing ends.

Magnitude is a canonical assumption. gcsim a1Init computes Rescue Essentials as m = 60 + max(teamNightsoul-60,0)*c2Mult, capped at 150+c2CapIncrease; at C0 c2Mult=0 so m=60 (fixed reference). Authored at 60 points -> Swirl/EC 60*1.5% = 90; Lunar-Charged 60*0.2% = 12. Real value scales with live party Nightsoul (decays as Ifa's own 80 drains over the 10s hover).

Bound to the Nightsoul window via trigger onCast(skill) + duration 10 (the hover length), target team. The Swirl + Electro-Charged portion is authored as an `elevate` (reactions pyro/hydro/cryo/electroSwirl + electroCharged) — the semantically-correct reaction-DMG-bonus type — but multi-reaction elevate is not yet rendered and elevate does not map to a capability, so it is documentary. The Lunar-Charged portion IS authored as a buff on lunarChargedDmgBonus so at least one team-buff capability surfaces for the Team Builder. FLAG: the schema has no swirlDmgBonus / electroChargedDmgBonus stat key, so Ifa's HEADLINE Swirl/Electro-Charged team buff cannot surface as a capability today — needs a schema addition or multi-reaction-elevate rendering/capability mapping.

[A7] Caveat trimmed to the shown Lunar-Charged buff's fixed-60-point canonical assumption. The Swirl + Electro-Charged share (the passive's headline: +1.5% each per Rescue Essentials point, +90% at 60 points) is authored as multi-reaction elevate, which is frozen/unrendered and maps to no capability, so it never surfaces — the old '+90% shown' framing was inaccurate and was dropped rather than restated.

[A7] Rescue Essentials = total party Nightsoul, cap 150 (C0) / 200 (C2); per-point rates +1.5% Swirl, +1.5% Electro-Charged, +0.2% Lunar-Charged. 60 points is the fixed C0 reference magnitude the source used for the authored values (Swirl/EC 90%, Lunar-Charged 12%).
passives.description: When Ifa is in the Nightsoul's Blessing state, every 1 Nightsoul point out of the current total in his entire party will grant him 1 **Rescue Essentials** point. Rescue Essentials will increase the Swirl, Stellar Swirl, Electro-Charged, and Lunar-Charged reaction DMG dealt by nearby party members.

constellations.name: Oath on a Feathered Knot
_curatorNotes: C6 confirmed against gcsim PR #2639 cons.go c6OnHoldAttackSkill (Base.Cons < 6 guard): on Hold Supporting Fire, 50% chance (Rand > 0.5 skip) to fire an extra 'Tonic Shot C6' at Mult 1.2 = 120% ATK Anemo, tagged AttackTagNormal (Normal Attack DMG). Tap Supporting Fire cannot proc it. Kept as a manual-trigger damage effect: the 50% probability and Hold-only gating are not expressible in the schema, so it is not auto-fired to avoid over-rendering at 100% rate. The C6 extra Tonicshot deals damage only (no healCB in gcsim), so no heal is authored for it.

↻ EFFECT RETIRED 2026-09-21 (manual-trigger retirement, docs/manual-trigger-retirement-round.md). C6 — Oath on a Feathered Knot — effects[0] (damage, atk 120 anemo) carried `trigger: manual` and reached no surface. gcsim: `ifa/cons.go:64-104` — `c6OnHoldAttackSkill` returns early on `c.Core.Rand.Float64() > 0.5` (line 69), else queues one "Tonic Shot C6" (`Mult: 1.2`, Anemo, `Durability: 25`, `AttackTagNormal`) 12 frames later, and only if `nightsoulState.HasBlessing()` still holds. Retained: `description` keeps the mechanic. Keep the curator note's measured facts (gcsim `c6OnHoldAttackSkill`, Mult 1.2, `AttackTagNormal`, Hold-only, damage-only with no `healCB`) and REPLACE its closing sentence — "Kept as a manual-trigger damage effect … not auto-fired" is no longer true once the effect is gone; the reason is now the standing ruling that a coin flip is never drawn at 100% uptime (Ayaka C1 precedent), plus damage magnitudes having no pixel. ⚠️ none. Authoring it as an `onHit` proc with an `application[]` would paint an Anemo pip on every Hold Tonicshot, i.e. at double the in-game rate — exactly the over-render the original curator refused.
constellations.description:
When Ifa uses the Hold version of his **Supporting Fire**, there is a 50% chance that he will fire an additional Tonicshot that deals 120% of Ifa's ATK as Anemo DMG. This DMG is considered Normal Attack DMG.
Additionally, when he is not in combat, Ifa will consume 20% less Nightsoul points and Phlogiston in his Nightsoul's Blessing state.

notModeled.reason: This extra shot fires on a 50% chance. The Rotation Planner doesn't simulate chance, so the same rotation always draws the same bars for everyone.

_curatorNotes: ↻ 7.0 (genshin-db 5.2.13, 2026-08-31): kit text rewritten from "Swirl" to "Swirl or Stellar Swirl", so `stellarSwirl` joins the trigger. ⚓ Needed because a Stellar Swirl enabler (Sandrone/Odette/Cryo Traveler) REPLACES every Cryo Swirl party-wide — without this the effect would go dark in those teams. ⛔ Only added where HoYo actually renamed the text: a buff on the base reaction is NOT a buff on the converted one, so characters whose text was left alone (Venti, Lohen) stay as-is. ⚠️ IFA also gained **Lunar-Charged**: "Rescue Essentials will increase the Swirl, Stellar Swirl, Electro-Charged, and Lunar-Charged reaction DMG". ⚠️ This elevate lists seven reactions, so `normalizeBuffLikeEffect` still renders NOTHING for it (only a single reaction or a whole family maps to a stat) — pre-existing, not caused by this edit.
